units.source_text: 两人对视微笑，都非常心满意足。

en.t: The two looked at each other and smiled, both completely satisfied.

units.source_text: ——此时，良雄背后的拉门上出现了一个人影，

en.t: Just then, a figure appeared on the sliding door behind Yoshio,

units.source_text: 人影的一只手伸到门拉手上，影子便消失了，身材健壮的早水藤左卫门回到了房间。

en.t: One hand of the figure reached for the door pull; the shadow vanished, and the sturdy Hayamizu Tozaemon returned to the room.

units.source_text: 如果不是如此，良雄一定还会心满意得的继续沉浸在早春温暖和煦的阳光里。

en.t: If not for that, Yoshio would surely have gone on basking contentedly in the warm, gentle sunlight of early spring.

units.source_text: 然而当面色红润的藤左卫门面带笑容的地来到他俩面前，毫不客气的把他们拉回到现实生活里；

en.t: But when the ruddy-faced Tozaemon came smiling up to the two of them, he unceremoniously pulled them back into real life;

units.source_text: 至于他们呢，自然没有察觉到这一点。

en.t: As for them, of course they had not noticed this.
